rules.title: Spokane ban on purchasing algorithmic coordinating services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not purchase algorithmic coordinating services. The city enforces the ban, with civil penalties of up to $5,000 per violation.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $5,000 per violation

coverage.summary: The source states no building, unit-count or landlord-size coverage limits. It applies to landlords in Spokane.

rules.effective_date_note: The only source (a law-firm alert) gives the effective date as January 2026, month only. No exact day is documented. Either way the ban is in force as of the query date, 2026-10-01.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from purchasing algorithmic coordinating services; city enforcement includes civil penalties of up to $5,000 per violation.
rules.review_note: Supported only by a secondary source (Morgan Lewis alert, Aug. 21, 2026). The official ordinance text is not captured. The following are unverified: exact effective date, enactment date, ordinance number, definitions of 'coordinating services', exemptions, and whether there is a private right of action.
rules.source_notes: Secondary source: law-firm alert summary table row for Spokane, WA.
